Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Jones
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 02/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 17 as introduced would require the Department of Examiners of Public Accounts to perform audits on non-profit corporations that provide water services to the public and that are not organized by a county or municipality as a public corporation. This would increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Examiners of Public Accounts by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost of each audit or examination performed on each provider, which would be offset by the Department of the Examiners of Public Accounts ability to charge a reasonable fee for services performed.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Jones
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 03/30/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 17 as passed the Senate would allow the Department of Examiners of Public Accounts to perform biennial audits or examinations of certain non-profit corporations that provide water services to the public. This could increase the administrative obligations of the Department by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost of each audit or examination performed on each provider, which would be offset by reasonable fees charged by the Department for services performed.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government

Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Jones
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 04/14/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 17 as amended and reported by the Committee on State Government would allow the Department of Examiners of Public Accounts to perform a single audit or examination of certain non-profit corporations that provide water services to the public. This could increase the administrative obligations of the Department by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost of the audit or examination performed on each provider, which would be offset by reasonable fees charged by the Department for services performed.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
